verdict.rationale: AI Gateway documents an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint that reaches multiple providers through a single URL, and lets you switch providers by changing the model parameter. However, nothing in the evidence mentions tool or function calling, or a consistent tool schema across providers. A unified chat-completion format is an adjacent feature, not documented cross-provider tool calling, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can make tool and function calls across different providers with a consistent schema
